subject: Operations
title: Offshoring vs. Outsourcing
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Offshoring vs. Outsourcing.

hook.text: Nike doesn't own a single factory. It outsources everything. Apple offshores to Foxconn. The difference matters.

buildup.text: Offshoring moves your own operations to another country. Outsourcing hands operations to an external company.

discovery.text: You can offshore without outsourcing (your factory abroad) or outsource without offshoring (local contractor).

twist.text: Many companies offshore and outsource simultaneously—hiring a foreign contractor—getting both benefits and both risks.

climax.text: The choice depends on control needs, cost targets, intellectual property risk, and available capabilities.

punchline.text: Know whether you're moving the work or giving it away.

quiz.question: What is offshoring?
options: Moving your operations to another country
